technical_gate.note: The exact immutable FBX hash, bounds, renderer/filter counts, six external remaps and repeatable Unity import count are accepted. The ten-triangle Unity representation delta is recorded without modifying the FBX. These technical passes do not imply visual approval.

accepted_and_frozen_for_r2: The Root-approved EmberCoil normalized FBX, import orientation, bounds, identity root, 19 renderer/filter hierarchy, six external URP remaps, GUIDs and source hash remain frozen.
The exclusion of legacy ColdWhiteCore is correct and remains mandatory.
The endpoint timing and clean-stage evidence times remain useful lifecycle targets, but cycles are not authorized until visual proof passes.
failed_findings: Muzzle and Impact are dominated by a large thin smooth ellipse, reading as a toy ring or selection marker rather than a compact neutral-energy pressure event.

The retained CoreBurst and SoftBloom billboards appear as clipped, overexposed white and pale-blue square cards. Their hard rectangular edges remain obvious in both endpoint frames and the comparison sheet.
Impact is essentially the same ring-plus-square construction at larger intensity. It lacks a distinct contact plane, compression, asymmetric discharge and decay structure.

The Flight spiral is an overthick blown-out white tube. From hero and macro angles it reads as several repeated hoops or a coil cage, obscures the approved body and creates hard star-like spark/junction artifacts.

The spiral's visual weight and radius greatly exceed the body's authored coil channel. Even though its rear endpoint is numerically touching, the visible form does not look seated or load-related to the body.

At gameplay scale the body becomes very small while the white spiral and endpoint rings dominate. The result fails the recipe's own rejection rules and is far below the user's commercial/school quality floor.

r2_derived_visual_contract.scope: Freeze the imported body and all original Production49 source prefabs/materials. Build item-only derived visual assets under the StrictCustomDerived path; never overwrite source assets. Preserve neutral cool-white identity, endpoint durations, local/nonloop behavior and no ColdWhiteCore.
r2_derived_visual_contract.source_reuse_boundary: The R1 visible SmoothRing, CoreBurst/SoftBloom card presentation and ColdWhiteSpiral geometry are rejected as final visuals. They may remain immutable provenance/timing references, but R2 must not expose the blocky source cards or the overthick hoop geometry in the accepted composite.
r2_derived_visual_contract.muzzle: Create one compact axial cool-white discharge seated to the muzzle: a small offset white-hot core, two unequal short pale-cyan pressure lobes, one very narrow broken containment ripple subordinate to the core, and two or three short broad ion fragments. No complete ellipse, square card, star, spoke, needle, pill or radial flower.
r2_derived_visual_contract.flight: Create one open discontinuous 2.0-to-2.5-turn pale-cyan spiral wake whose radius follows the approved body's coil-channel envelope and whose thickness is no more than roughly one third of the R1 tube. It must taper toward -Z, maintain clear body visibility, avoid complete repeated hoops from hero/gameplay angles and visibly seat at the rear channel. Add only sparse soft point sparks with no starburst sprite or hard square edge.
r2_derived_visual_contract.impact: Create a different compact neutral contact event: one flattened contact core aligned to +Z normal, two unequal overturning cool-white lobes, one restrained broken pressure ripple and three short substantial ion fragments. Peak must be wider than contact and decay into two readable masses, not reuse the Muzzle composition or a giant ring.
r2_derived_visual_contract.rendering: Use clean RGBA item-only masks or tapered mesh sheets with transparent RGB zero, sufficient texture resolution and isolated black/neutral-gray proof for every renderer. Preserve a small unclipped near-white core and pale-cyan structure without blowing the whole form to white.
r2_derived_visual_contract.proof_gate: First produce isolated black/gray renderer proofs and one composite Muzzle, Flight and Impact frame at original 1024x768, including true body-contact macro and gameplay scale. Stop for Root proof review before full timing implementation or 30-cycle lifecycle tests.
r2_derived_visual_contract.lifecycle_after_visual_go: Only after Root visual approval, run 30 natural/interrupted cycles per stage and audit particles, renderer visibility, material instances, GUIDs, prefab hierarchy, residue, console and scene dirty state.
